title: SS27 Toddler Boys' First Summer
summary: Soft first summers for toddler boys: organic cotton sets, first-walker sandals and sun hats.
research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Premium and mid-market childrenswear, Europe-led fairs, global retail

sections.heading: The story
sections.body: Pisamonas showed first-summer shoes for babies and barefoot models <sup>[1]</sup>; Cozmo dresses newborns upward in striped tees and sets <sup>[1]</sup>; Salt and Pepper uses soft organic cotton <sup>[2]</sup>. Most SS27 kidswear sources describe collections across ages and genders. The evidence below is the fair record; the shapes, products and sizes are Forecut's application of it to toddler boys, roughly 1 to 4 years.

sections.heading: Silhouettes
sections.body:
- Short rompers and two-piece sets.
- Pull-on shorts.
- Sun hats.

sections.heading: Fabrics
sections.body: - Organic cotton jersey and interlock, muslin.

sections.heading: Trims and details
sections.body: - Snap closures, flat seams, printed labels.

design_implications:
- Easy dressing: snaps at the crotch, wide neck openings.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
